FlyDocs v1.3.22 — spec-driven development for AI coding agents

  USAGE  flydocs <command> [options]

  COMMANDS
    init        Set up FlyDocs in this project
    update      Update the CLI and refresh everything from the server
    rollback    Restore the previously installed release of managed files
    run         Run a workflow operation by ID (flydocs run --list)
    mcp         Run the MCP server over stdio (spawned by your editor)
    doctor      Diagnose the local environment and usage capture
    usage       AI usage counters — summary, capture log, opt-out
    stream      Read the session records written at every wrap
    skills      Manage FlyDocs skills
    connect     Connect FlyDocs to a cloud provider, or `connect codex`
    disconnect  Remove an integration FlyDocs registered (`disconnect codex`)
    auth        Store your API key globally
    scan        Generate project context with a server-side AI scan
    rules       Evaluate and adopt workspace rule files
    clean       Remove legacy artifacts (--v1 for pre-migration cleanup)
    cloud       Learn about FlyDocs Cloud and upgrade from local
    telemetry   Manage anonymous usage analytics
    uninstall   Remove FlyDocs from a project

  Aliases: sync → update, self-update → update, cleanup → clean --v1, upgrade → cloud, install → init

  Run flydocs <command> --help for options. Agent commands like /activate run in your IDE.
